On this page

API Dashboard ​

Open API Dashboard from the app menu to manage keys for the public API. Your API key identifies your account; keep it private and use separate keys for separate integrations.

Keys and folders ​

  • Create a sk_live_ key and copy the full value immediately. It is shown only once.
  • Give each key a descriptive nickname and optionally group it in a folder.
  • Review its preview, creation date, status and available credits.
  • Revoke a key you no longer use to prevent further authentication.
PlanActive keys
Free3
Pro20
DevUnlimited

Revoked keys do not occupy an active-key slot. See Authentication for using a key safely.

Credits and usage ​

The dashboard shows each key's available API credits. Public API requests consume credits according to the endpoint costs. An empty key balance may use an available App Credit and return X-Credit-Warning; surface that warning in your integration.

API credit purchases and money-wallet top-ups are unavailable. A donation is not a credit purchase. Check the account's displayed balance before making requests; do not assume a future plan or purchase will add credits.

Help ​

Replay the API Dashboard tour from Settings → Tutorials. For failed requests, check the API errors and response headers.
